-- Verification surface: logic fns, contracts, totality, disciplines.
logic fn nonneg(x : Int) : Bool = x >= 0

fn clamp(x : Int, lo : Int, hi : Int) : Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures |r| nonneg(r)
  =
    if x < lo then
      lo
    elif x > hi then
      hi
    else
      x

total fn down(n : Int) : Int
  decreases n
  =
    if n <= 0 then
      0
    else
      down(n - 1)

assume total fn trusted(n : Int) : Int = n

test fn clamp_holds() = assert_eq(clamp(5, 0, 3), 3)

fip fn swap(p : (Int, Int)) : (Int, Int) =
  match p of
    (a, b) => (b, a)
